description: Shows one model, such as the Rolex Daytona or Patek Philippe Nautilus: how many are listed now with typical prices, the dials it comes in with their prices, and its references. Use it when the customer asks in words for an overview of a model (its dials, references and typical prices). Not for finding a watch: a named reference or nickname is searched with search_watches, whose listings come first.

query.description: The model, such as "rolex daytona" or "nautilus".

name: explore_model
title: Show a watch model
